requirements.description: Three equal base-wager units fund a five-card poker round with three player cards and two staged ride-or-pull decisions before community-card settlement beginning at a pair of tens.
requirements.notes: Issue #77 allocates the permanent distinct rules requirement for issue #134.

requirements.description: Authenticated sessions own private reload-safe decision rounds, hidden community cards, durable receipts, settled history, and canonical route restoration.
requirements.notes: Session context overrides caller player ids, unrevealed community cards remain private, and committed results survive reload and process restart.

requirements.description: Opening wager debits, pull refunds, and returned-token payout credits use the shared ledger exactly once under durable action identities.
requirements.notes: No game code mutates balances directly and conflicting retries fail closed.

requirements.description: Let It Ride supplies complete English and Russian responsive, accessible, reduced-motion-safe, timer-clean play.
requirements.notes: Evidence covers both locales and every governed viewport.

requirements.description: Catalog, contract, browser, and long-suite discovery include Let It Ride with requirement, module, version, and visual traceability.
requirements.notes: Descriptor sort order 280 and the catalog-discovered long driver are canonical.

requirements.description: Let It Ride publishes prepared rounds, staged ride-or-pull decisions, request ownership, ledger recovery markers, terminal results, and uncommitted-action rollback through provider-current callbacks that replace only game-owned fields. Competing processes preserve unrelated player-state siblings and fail closed before a stale second decision or rejected-movement cleanup can overwrite or resurrect the winning round, while staged rules, paytable returns, and exactly-once ledger movements retain frozen v1 behavior.
requirements.notes: The frozen v1 contract, three-unit opening wager, staged decision rules, paytable, ledger transaction types, and action keys remain unchanged. Production multiworker activation stays blocked because wallet and game-state publication remain separate durable boundaries.
